checkedAlternates.risk: Constitutional monarchies like the UK or Japan are parliamentary democracies.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A constitutional monarchy retains a hereditary monarch as head of state (group-2), unlike non-monarchical republics (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Absolute monarchy concentrates unchecked power in one ruler.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Absolute monarchy is defined by hereditary royal succession (group-2), distinct from modern non-hereditary autocracies (group-4).
